svg.title: PNPrank
svg.desc: Animated banner. A myelinated axon serves as a time axis from 2005 to 2026. An action potential jumps between nodes of Ranvier; as it passes, each of 70 neuropathy genes appears at the position PNPrank gave it genome-wide in the year it was reported, and 9 of them land in the top 1%. A terminal shows pnprank top, query and interval commands.
svg.text: Ranking candidate genes with public single-cell atlases,
tested on the genes reported after each cutoff year.
Each tier-1 gene, ranked genome-wide in the year it was reported
Model trained only on the genes known before that year (2005–2026, n = 70)
myelinated axon as the time axis; nodes of Ranvier at the cutoff years

g.text: 9 of 70 genes were in the top 1% of the genome in the year they were reported
